unstated_details: The date-cluster universe of a season is the sorted unique game_date of the stored model rows; one resample matrix per season (default_rng(2026)) is shared by every cell; the week sensitivity uses weeks of the same dates with default_rng(2028).

T2's excess E re-estimates the legs' mean marginal residual g inside every bootstrap replicate from the resampled dates' legs (g is a fitted quantity); a fixed-g interval is narrower. The point estimates are exactly gate_module.estimators.
Pooled T1/T2/rho and ROI use parlay weights across seasons; a directional word also needs the same sign of its statistic in each season.

The p-value of T1 and T2 is the two-sided date-clustered bootstrap p of the cell's pooled statistic; the money p is one-sided (ROI <= 0); BH runs over the 10 cells of each family, the two 85 cells included although they get no word.
Single-leg comparator C1 is the mean single-leg ROI over the leg appearances of the cell's parlays; by-stat slices are over those leg appearances too.
Plan draws: one default_rng(2026) per plan call, seasons ascending, weeks ascending; a parlay is a one-outcome unit, so only the 'draw 10 of the week's parlays' step applies.
